PHASES: Rosa writes a record. It lands on the ground and never changes.
A store holds it, as one member of a set.
A view settles what this reader holds.
A fold works out the state: what is current, and how many.
A tick fixes that answer at a moment, so others can cite it.
A lens renders the answer as text people read.
Someone edits the text. The edit comes back down as a new record.

observer: Who says it. Today that is the key that signed it, k:….
emitted: When it was written, in RFC 3339, set by the writer.
kind: What sort of record it is. Any word; a source selects by it.
of: The one thing it is about. Heads are worked out thing by thing.
occurred: When what it describes happened, only as exactly as anyone knows: here a decade, 1960 up to 1970.
payload: What was seen. Kept apart from the envelope, so it can be withheld or erased.
prev: The records it replaces, inside the same thing.
erases: Payloads it removes. The erased record keeps its id and its place.
under: The grant it acts on. Nothing writes this yet: see IS3.
id: A hash of everything above, written one canonical way. Try it below.

REBUILD: Copied again from any other place that holds the records. A store is a set, so any complete copy is the same store.
Settled again from what this reader holds.
Folded again from the set. The same records give the same slots, in any order.
Worked out again from the records it covers. Anyone who holds them gets the same tick.
Rendered again from its base by the lens. The same base gives the same text.
